From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: TalentOps <talentops@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interview loop coverage: Jordan Miles — rotation & backfills

Team —

We have Jordan Miles (Sr ML Eng) scheduled for on-site style interviews June 7 (virtual). The current panel is light on system-design coverage late in the day, and one interviewer (Raj) had to drop out unexpectedly. I attached the latest panel schedule (interview_panel_schedule.xlsx) and the candidate resume for context.

Asks:
- Can someone cover System Design (slot 3, 1:30–2:15pm) if available?
- If you take a slot that conflicts with another commitment, please indicate a backup (short notice backfill).
- Please confirm whether you can join the 30m debrief immediately after the loop (2:45–3:15pm).

Notes:
- We prefer someone who can discuss LLM deployment/infra tradeoffs but any senior ML infra or research engineer will work.
- Candidate is interviewing for a role on Platform/Serving.

I can swap people across slots to balance load — want to avoid overloading a single interviewer with >3 interviews this week.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Hiring Manager, Platform ML
Redwood Inference
